result.summary: Found 2 issues: critical low-contrast promo banner text that is nearly unreadable, and a minor inconsistency in favorite icon button styling.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a very light mint green background and is barely legible due to insufficient contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color that meets WCAG contrast requirements against the light banner background, e.g. dark green/black text instead of white.

issues.description: Favorite/heart button styling is inconsistent in 'Popular right now' list: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white heart outline with no circular background, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent styling to all favorite buttons, ensuring the dark circular background/container is present on all cards for visibility and tap target consistency.
